why_manifest_only: NLLB.en-ti.ti is 137 MB and NLLB.en-ti.en is 83 MB (~220 MB total, 1,398,173 lines each). NLLB.en-ti.ti alone exceeds GitHub's 100 MB per-file limit, so the bitext cannot be committed to this repository without Git LFS. This manifest -- exact file names, byte size, line count, SHA256 of each file, the OPUS download URL, and the train/valid/test sample sizes -- is the reproducible substitute: download from the OPUS URL and verify against the sha256 values.
